FN-DAWMNHT-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 10
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/18/2025
Senate Bill 10 as introduced could increase receipts to: (1) the State General Fund from civil
penalties imposed for using an electronic nicotine delivery system in violation of the provisions
of the Alabama Clean Indoor Act by a maximum of $50 for the first violation, $100 for a second
violation, and $200 for each subsequent violation; and (2) the district or municipal courts by an
undetermined amount, dependent on the increase in the number of violations pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.
